ssl.label: 06-23 swing low, swept 08-14 and marginally reclaimed
06-10 swing low — next real pool below the void

narrative: Eight consecutive sessions of lower highs and lower lows off the 08-05 high at 27550.00, with the 07-31 break under the 07-24 low at 26425.00 marking the change of character. On 08-14 price took the 06-23 low at 24765.00, trading to 24600.00, but the close at 24795.00 is only 0.12% back above the swept level -- a technical reclaim with no conviction behind it. The draw is lower: beneath 24600.00 there is no detected swing low until 23290.00, so a break there runs into a liquidity void rather than a shelf of support. The trade is to sell the retrace rather than the break, because the 25150.00-25570.00 bearish order block sits directly above and overlaps the OTE.
invalidation: A daily close above 25700.00 puts price back inside the 08-12/08-13 highs and above the bearish order block, which would make the 08-14 sweep of 24765.00 a genuine reversal rather than a failed reclaim. The thesis is already weakening on any close above 25575.00.
